benchmark: Phase 1 CDVQA Paired Cluster-Bootstrap Analysis (ChangeNet vs Blind)
description: Paired cluster-bootstrap 95% confidence intervals evaluating whether ChangeNet visual features provide statistically significant improvement over language prior alone.

statistical_procedure_details.statistic: Paired difference in accuracy (Delta = ChangeNet - Blind)
statistical_procedure_details.resampling_procedure: 1,000 cluster-bootstrap resamples over 400 validation scene pairs with replacement (all QAs per sampled pair concatenated)
statistical_procedure_details.p_value_calculation: Non-numeric heuristic (statistically_significant = true iff 95% percentile interval excludes 0.0)
statistical_procedure_details.multiple_comparison_correction: None applied. Per-category intervals are uncorrected nominal 95% CIs (alpha=0.05). Bonferroni control across 8 categories would require a 99.375% interval [0.3125%, 99.6875%].
statistical_procedure_details.uncertainty_scope: Measures finite-sample evaluation uncertainty across geospatial scenes for a single model checkpoint (Seed 42). Distinct from 3-seed Student's t-test which evaluates training/optimization variance.
